items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: the comedians, like Redd Foxx used to come up there and try out his material and I'd get right there with him and be a straight man for him

ctx.x: Oh yeah, we had...we'd change them around. We had the favorites, you know. "Cherry Red" was one and...I think "The Dreamer" was one... oh it was several, you know. (laughter) Shake dancer was a part of the, you know, the Harlem scene. A comedian was a part of the Harlem scene. And a singer was part of the Harlem scene. But I was able to get over because I was playin' good music and I was singin' a little bit, scat singin'. And the people know I was really tryin' to entertain 'em. And like all the entertainers…
